outcome: Admission to neonatal intensive care unit
cohort: 196 women with isolated oligohydramnios at term, compared to 8,676 women with normal amniotic fluid volume
finding: Women with isolated oligohydramnios at term did not have worse perinatal outcomes, but had higher rates of cesarean section and abnormal cardiotocography, particularly in nulliparous women.
mod_finding: Cesarean section rates were significantly higher in the isolated oligohydramnios group, particularly in nulliparous women.
